note: Ragdoll art for the eight `Phys*` clips (2041-2048). One atlas per clip; `origin` is the SWF registration point inside a cell, in clip units (1 px at bake scale). `frames` maps a costume index to a cell; `layers`/`order` describe the named nested costume children (`skin`/`face`/`hair`/`robot`) that must be drawn at the recorded placement matrices, in order. Baked by tools/ragdoll/bake_ragdoll.py.
